summary: Iteration 59: Mobile Responsiveness & Component Refactoring Testing. Fixed critical CSS bug causing mobile sidebar to have 0 width. All refactored components (Topbar, TeacherLessonsHub, SchemeOfWork) render correctly on both mobile and desktop.

bug_fixed.issue: Mobile sidebar had width: 0 due to CSS rule `.sidebar { width: 0; overflow: hidden; }` in @media (max-width: 768px) block
bug_fixed.root_cause: CSS was setting sidebar width to 0 on mobile, conflicting with the Tailwind translate-x approach used in DashboardLayout.jsx
bug_fixed.fix: Removed the CSS rules that set sidebar width to 0 on mobile. The sidebar visibility is now controlled by the parent container's translate-x transform

Login page renders correctly on mobile (390px)
Login with CEO credentials works
Dashboard loads after login
Hamburger menu button (data-testid=menu-toggle-btn) visible on mobile

Sidebar close button (data-testid=sidebar-close-btn) works
Mobile overlay (data-testid=mobile-overlay) appears when sidebar open
Clicking overlay closes sidebar
Navigation via sidebar works on mobile (Lessons, Scheme of Work)
Sidebar closes automatically after navigation
Term selector (data-testid=term-selector) dropdown works
Notifications bell (data-testid=notifications-btn) dropdown works
User menu (data-testid=user-menu-trigger) dropdown works
User menu shows Profile, Change Password, Logout options
Topbar refactored into sub-components (SearchBar, NotificationDropdown, TermSelector, UserMenu)
TeacherLessonsHub refactored - ManagementView loads correctly
TeacherLessonsHub shows stats cards (5 cards: Total, Pending, Under Review, Approved, Returned)
TeacherLessonsHub shows tabs (Submissions, Compliance, Overdue, Templates)
TeacherLessonsHub table has overflow-x-auto for mobile scrolling
SchemeOfWork refactored - ManagementView loads correctly
SchemeOfWork shows stats cards (5 cards)
SchemeOfWork shows tabs (Submissions, Compliance, Overdue)
SchemeOfWork table has overflow-x-auto for mobile scrolling

Responsive grid: Stats cards stack 2 columns on mobile, 5 columns on desktop
